audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer states the range asymmetry. Riven's entire damage kit is point-blank — Broken Wings 275, Ki Burst 260, Valor 250 — while Zac's Stretching Strikes reaches 800. Both layers describe Zac's Q as 'slow' and treat her as unapproachable, but never mention that he outranges her by roughly 3x.
audit.why: This is the only way a Zac wins a lane phase against Riven, and it is completely absent. Her whole win condition is getting inside 275 units; his is never being there. Framing his Q as a liability rather than as the longest-reaching thing in the lane sends the player into exactly the spacing Riven wants.
audit.corrected: Zac's Q reaches 800. Riven's longest basic ability reaches 275. Every point of damage you take in lane is damage you volunteered for by stepping inside her range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riven is resourceless; every Zac ability costs a percentage of current health. Neither layer mentions the cost asymmetry anywhere, and content wants.you[1] tells the player to 'Stack Q for the heal to offset her poke'.
audit.why: It reverses who pays for a poke war. Riven can throw her whole rotation at a wave forever at zero cost; Zac pays health for every Q, W and E and only gets it back if he walks onto the blob, which is precisely what her mobility denies. 'Stack Q for the heal' is a losing loop against a champion who can contest every blob for free.
audit.corrected: Riven pays nothing to cast. Zac pays current health for Q, W and E. Poke only when the blob is safely collectable; otherwise you are the only one spending.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers describe Blade of the Exile (R) only as burst plus a Wind Slash execute. Riot's text says it grants Attack Damage and Range.
audit.why: The bonus attack range is the part that actually kills Zac players. A Zac who has spent five levels learning the safe distance to Riven finds that distance is inside her reach the moment she ults, and nothing in the entry warns him to re-measure. Reading her ult as 'more damage' rather than 'more damage and more reach' is how the level-6 death happens.
audit.corrected: Blade of the Exile grants bonus Attack Damage and bonus Attack Range for its duration, plus one Wind Slash. Your pre-6 spacing is no longer safe spacing.
sources: champ-data/_kits/riven.json (Blade of the Exile: 'gains Attack Damage and Range')

audit.whatIsWrong: full breakdown.cooldowns names Ki Burst as 'Her engage CC. E-knock/bait it' with no numbers, and content gives no cooldown for any Riven ability.
audit.why: The entry is built entirely on 'trade around Ki Burst' but never says how long that window lasts. The real numbers matter here because she has three separate answers on three different clocks — Ki Burst 11s at rank 1, the full Broken Wings rotation 13s, Valor 10s — so 'her cooldown is down' is never a single fact.
audit.corrected: Ki Burst 11/10/9/8/7s. Broken Wings 13s flat for all three casts, third knocks back. Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, dash plus shield.

audit.why: 51.11% over 135 games against a chart reading Riven 6/7 with the last stage as Skill is a defensible split for a lane that is genuinely hard early and evens out on Zac's item curve. No chart change proposed.

edits.before: Riven's three Broken Wings (Q) dashes plus Ki Burst (W) stun let her weave in and out of your slow Q; her mobility makes landing E-slingshot nearly impossible.
edits.after: Riven's whole kit reaches under 280 units — Broken Wings 275, Ki Burst 260, Valor 250 — and your Q reaches 800. Poke from max range; stepping closer is her lane.

edits.before: Riven bullies 1-3: her Broken Wings (Q) triple-dash and Ki Burst (W) stun let her trade and reposition faster than your slow Q and E can punish.
edits.after: Riven bullies 1-3 up close, but her casts are free and yours cost current health — a poke war inside her range bleeds only you, so farm from 800 out.

edits.before: Through 4-6 she stays ahead — her mobility dodges your engage and at 6 Blade of the Exile (R) with Wind Slash execute threatens a kill on any low-HP mistake.
edits.after: Through 4-6 she stays ahead — her mobility dodges your engage, and Blade of the Exile (R) at 6 grants bonus attack range, so your pre-6 spacing is now too close.

edits.before: At 2 Ki Burst (W) stun opens winning combos your unfinished kit can't answer.
edits.after: At 2 Ki Burst (W) stuns on an 11s clock and cancels your E charge cold.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile (R) at 6 adds execute pressure past your R disengage.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile (R) at 6 adds attack range, not just extra damage.

edits.before: Stack Q for the heal to offset her poke and scale to two items
edits.after: Poke from 800 with Q — each cast costs you health, so land it

edits.before: Weave Broken Wings (Q) dashes to dodge your slow abilities
edits.after: Close inside 275 where her whole kit reaches and yours is spent

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot from fog + R bounces win every river fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile grants bonus attack range as well as AD — spacing that was safe at 5 sits inside her reach at 6. Remeasure before trading.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. E-knock/bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ki Burst: 11s at rank 1 — her stun, and it cancels your E charge. - Broken Wings: 13s for all three casts, the third knocks back. - Valor: 10s, dash plus shield. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: The two genuinely missing facts were both range and cost, not mechanics. Zac's Q reaches 800; Riven's longest ability reaches 275 — a 3x edge the entry never mentions while repeatedly calling his Q 'slow'. And Riven is resourceless while every Zac cast costs current health, so the existing 'stack Q for the heal' advice is a losing loop against a champion who can contest every blob for free. Third find: Blade of the Exile grants bonus attack RANGE as well as AD (Riot's own wording), which is why pre-6 spacing gets Zac killed at 6 — both layers described it as burst only. Left alone: whys[3] says 'animation-cancel burst'. Animation cancels are in the kit's needsResearch block (i.e. unknown from Riot data), so I did not extend or sharpen that claim, only left the existing wording untouched. No level-chart change — 51.11% over 135 games is consistent with the current split.
